'''Tear-gas grenades''' were non-lethal [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. They released an eye-irritating gas that incapacitated targets. They were used by the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Ga'p'tashi]]; the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] among his crew were immune to the effects of the [[Gas/Legends|gas]], and the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] in his crew wore [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]].<ref name="PP" />
